items.title: Prisma v8.0.0-rc.19
items.summary: v8.0.0-rc.19 @default now means a database default, and values the client generates are written @onCreate(. ) and @onUpdate(. ) . Every default is stored in one form owned by its column's data type, so date, time and bytes defaults are written with tags. items.title: DeepSeek Open-Sources DeepInfer, the Inference Framework Behind DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash
items.summary: DeepSeek has open-sourced DeepInfer, the Apache 2.0 inference framework that serves DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash in production. It targets NVIDIA SM100 GPUs and Huawei Ascend 950 NPUs, and ships offline inference only. The post DeepSeek Open-Sources DeepInfer, the Inference Framework Behind DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash appeared first on MarkTechPost .
